text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After finishing lunch with Sirius Symboli, 
on our way to training, we spotted King 
Halo letting out a sigh.
choice_data_list:
You look a little pale... Sorry, I'll be 
right back!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As a Trainer, I couldn't just leave her 
be. I decided to call out to her.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, that puppy went and picked up 
another troublesome thing—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Haaah...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: —!? Y-You guys are...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Drawing closer... by her side was a 
mountain of snacks. Being full myself, my 
cheek twitched involuntarily.
choice_data_list:
What on earth is with all this candy 
wrapper trash...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Th-This is nothing—!
choice_data_list: There's no way it's nothing, right?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Spit out the reason already. Otherwise, 
this guy's not budging an inch from here.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ngh... ...Understood, I will speak.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"This is... the consolation prize from the 
lottery...!!"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, how many times did you draw? 
Did you really want that grand prize that 
badly?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...What I wanted was a 'first-rate' 
result.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Giving up after a loss is hardly 
first-rate! That is why—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep drawing again and again until I 
win...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: All I won was... the consolation prize.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: L-Laugh if you want to!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, who would... ...Taking 
responsibility for your own choices. 
Sounds fine to me.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Your aesthetics and choices aren't half 
bad.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Hey, hand over the bag already.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
!? No, this is something I should clean up 
myself, so—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I'm the one who decided to do this. So 
stop butting in.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
If she pushes herself any further and 
ruins her health, this guy will end up 
having to nurse her anyway. That would be 
even more of a nuisance.
choice_data_list: I'll eat it all by myself!!
I'll eat it all by myself!!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
If she pushes herself any further and 
ruins her health, this guy will end up 
having to nurse her anyway. That would be 
even more of a nuisance.
choice_data_list: I'll eat it all by myself!!
I'll eat it all by myself!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With both of them needing to make 
adjustments for the race, I can't let them 
push themselves too hard. As their 
Trainer, I told them I wouldn't budge on 
this.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hoh... Then let's see it. That resolve of 
yours.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I started feeling sick midway through, 
but... I somehow managed to clean the 
whole plate.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After successfully finishing all the 
sweets, I parted ways with King Halo on 
the walk home.

Respecting Sirius Symboli's opinion, I 
decided to just watch over the situation.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, this much is a piece of cake. Just 
be a good girl and watch from there.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as promised, Sirius Symboli devoured 
a massive pile of sweets all by herself.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: You really saved me this time.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Next time, for sure... I'll definitely win 
the 1st prize!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Dummy. Like I care about that crap.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back after parting with King 
Halo.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You made us totally late just 'cause you 
went and picked up some stray junk without 
your owner's permission, huh, puppy?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Well, for a little stray pup, you weren't 
a bad find at all."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Pushing yourself hard and refusing to give 
up— it's ridiculously straightforward, and 
I kinda like that.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
If you can't be headstrong and honest with 
yourself, there's no way in hell you'll 
ever be number one.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Where Sirius Symboli was looking, the 
evening star was beginning to shine.
